rule: keep a variant if, after calibrating K_D to the coupons' mean pit size (79 um, counting pits >= 20 um), its absolute N(pits >= 20 um) at Surveyor III lies between 1/3 x 103/cm^2 (coupon average) and 4000/cm^2 (tube maximum); variants with fewer than 20 simulated grains at Surveyor III, or whose calibration rests on fewer, are left out
source: pit_calibration.py on the full-resolution 11.6 kN cache
